messages:
sarah: FYI opened PR #4123 to refactor networking modules and normalize provider pins. moved to modules/network, hoisted root provider, and added explicit provider sources/versions. need a quick sanity check before i regen lockfile and push.
mohit: on it. did you change module inputs that could trigger a state move?
sarah: no state moves. kept resource addresses intact. just changed module structure and added providers = { aws = aws } for nested modules. pinned aws provider to 4.58.0 and replaced source with registry/hashicorp/aws.
jen: sounds good. for lockfile regen, please run the same platforms as our CI: linux_amd64 + linux_arm64. CI will fail otherwise. command i run locally:
```
terraform providers lock -platform=linux_amd64 -platform=linux_arm64 -dir=./terraform
```
mohit: also include the registry mirror in the env if you're on VPN: TF_REGISTRY_MIRROR="https://mirror.internal" so CI uses the same mirrors.
sarah: thanks — will do. one question: secrets wiring for k8s modules changed names for vault template data keys. i updated module var names but may have missed a callsite in k8s-ingress. anyone cross-check that?
dave: i'll grep the repo for "vault_template" keys and check helm values. if you push the branch i'll run a quick smoke in staging.
terraform-bot: CI pipeline triggered for branch sarah/module-refactor — plan started (job id 5237).
terraform-bot: plan output for staging (summary):
```
Terraform used the selected providers to generate the following execution plan.

Plan: 0 to add, 2 to change, 0 to destroy.

# changes are module-level pinned versions and metadata only. No resource address changes.
```
mohit: Nice, that looks safe. can you include a brief changelog in the PR describing the provider pin rationale and rollback steps? also add a note about running the lock regen command.
sarah: done — added changelog and included the exact terraform providers lock command in PR description. pushing lockfile now.
dave: verified k8s helm values: only one helm release needed a key rename fix (ingress.vault.templateData -> ingress.vault.template_data). i pushed a tiny commit to your branch.
jen: LGTM from infra side. :thumbsup:
mohit: LGTM as well — i'm happy to merge once the lockfile is committed and CI green.
sarah: thanks all — locking and merging after CI passes. will follow up if anything pops up in prod smoke.
